questions.stem: What is the chemical formula of washing soda?
questions.solution: Washing soda is a hydrated form of sodium carbonate, which has the chemical formula Na2CO3.10H2O. This formula indicates that each molecule of sodium carbonate is associated with ten molecules of water. Other options represent different substances, such as baking soda (NaHCO3) and common salt (NaCl), which are not washing soda.
